action.command:
cd /workspace/project && timeout 400 python3 - <<'PY'
import json,urllib.request,urllib.parse,os
tok=os.environ.get("GITHUB_TOKEN","")
def gh(q):
    u="https://api.github.com/search/repositories?q="+urllib.parse.quote(q,safe=":><")+"&sort=updated&per_page=6"
    h={"Accept":"application/vnd.github+json","User-Agent":"curl"}
    if tok: h["Authorization"]=f"Bearer {tok}"
    try:
        r=urllib.request.Request(u,headers=h)
        with urllib.request.urlopen(r,timeout=40) as x: return json.load(x)
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e: return {"err":e.code}
qs=["free api credits created:>2026-11-10","llm free tier created:>2026-11-10",
    "inference gateway created:>2026-11-10","uncensored api created:>2026-11-10",
    "free gpu created:>2026-11-10","ssh free server created:>2026-11-10",
    "awesome uncensored created:>2026-11-01","abliterated created:>2026-11-10"]
seen=set()
for q in qs:
    d=gh(q)
    if "err" in d: print(q,"-> err",d["err"]); continue
    print(f"\n### {q} (total {d.get('total_count')})")
    for it in d.get("items",[])[:6]:
        n=it["full_name"]
        if n in seen: continue
        seen.add(n)
        print(f"  [{it['created_at'][:10]}] {n} ⭐{it['stargazers_count']} — {(it.get('description') or '')[:95]}")
PY
